spec.name: sprint35_funding_settlement_drift_majors
spec.hypothesis: Perpetual funding settles every 8h (00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC); traders adjust positions around settlement to capture/avoid the payment, creating short-horizon directional flow signed by the about-to-settle funding rate. Distinct mechanism from qhour_open (VWAP-slicing, unrelated to funding) and from sprint05-08's carry (weekly cross-sectional rotation, not intraday timing) -- not a permutation of a closed family.
spec.power_argument: C0/C1 calibration: net_bps dispersion ~26-33bp std, T2 cost floor ~26bp -> min detectable edge at n=300, t=2 is ~2*30/sqrt(300)=3.46bp, below the cost floor, so the design can detect any deployable edge without being unfalsifiable. 3 settlements/day x 2 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap1/settlement = up to 552 possible entries; even at 60% qualifying-rate this clears the 300 floor.
spec.hard_blocker: signal not in factory.py SIGNALS dict yet -- needs sig_funding_settlement() added (fundingRate loader already exists in carry.py). Do NOT submit to proposals/ until added.
